When compiled with THEMIS_BASE_EXPORTS defined (i.e. as part of the themis_base shared library), THEMIS_BASE_API expands to __declspec(dllexport), which causes the MSVC linker to emit the implicit default constructor and virtual destructor of each abstract interface class. Without this translation unit those symbols are never emitted and every other module that derives from the interfaces fails to link with LNK2019 "__imp_??0..." / "__imp_??1..." errors.
Nothing else should be placed in this file.
